steps.en: Separately authorize setup and select a readable Photos library
steps.zh: 另行授权安装与访问，选择可读图库

steps.en: Choose a dedicated destination and request media with XMP sidecars
steps.zh: 指定独占目录，要求媒体及 XMP 随附文件

steps.en: Read library metadata and locate original and edited media
steps.zh: 读取图库信息，定位原片和编辑版

steps.en: Write available media, sidecars and the export-state database
steps.zh: 写出可用媒体、随附文件和导出状态库

steps.en: For later incremental runs, enable update and keep other required export options
steps.zh: 后续增量重跑须启用更新，并保留其他所需导出选项

value.en: A file archive carries Photos metadata without manually rebuilding every album
value.zh: 文件归档携带照片图库信息，无需手工重建每个相册
